name: Lateral Rib Expansion Breathing

instructions.description: Sit or stand tall and wrap your hands or a light band around the sides of the lower rib cage.
Inhale through the nose and direct the breath outward into the sides of the ribs.
Exhale slowly and feel the ribs settle inward without collapsing the chest.
Repeat smooth breaths while maintaining a relaxed neck and shoulders.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use slow repeated breaths emphasizing rib mobility.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use prone positioning to feel expansion into the back of the rib cage.

commentsNotes: Do not elevate the shoulders to breathe.
Keep the abdomen relaxed rather than rigid.
